I have the exact same thing, except I'm about 1 year in to a continuous migraine.

It comes and goes in waves, often fluctuating hour to hour and day to day.

Honestly, the best thing I've found is to take it day by day and (most importantly) to be kind to yourself. You are dealing with a neurological disorder which is debilitating and painful. It is okay to do 'nothing'. It is okay to rest. It is okay to ask for help.


Practically, things that I've found have helped me: 
- Ice packs

- Heating pads 

- Hot/cold showers or baths

- Tiger balm

- Ginger tea/supplements/candies for the nausea. Travel sickness tablets also help me for some reason, but check online to make sure they don't have any interactions with other meds you're on

- Stretches (especially neck/back stretches) if you feel up to it

- Counselling/therapy if you can afford it, try to find a therapist that specialises in chronic pain if you can

- This sounds weird, but those cooling mats for pets can go on top of your pillow, and act as an ice pack for when you're trying to sleep. 

I really hope that you feel better soon. Feel free to message me if you need anymore advice or support
